# Claude for Legal

> A Claude Code plugin marketplace providing 12 practice-area AI assistants for legal professionals — from commercial contracts to AI governance — each customizable to the user's practice profile, with built-in attorney oversight guardrails.

## Getting Started

- [Quick Start](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-for-legal/blob/main/QUICKSTART.md): 60 seconds.

## Guide

- [CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-for-legal/blob/main/CLAUDE.md): Guidance for working on this repo.
- [Adding a Connector](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-for-legal/blob/main/CONNECTORS.md): The plugins are at their best when connected to authoritative sources.
- [AI Governance Practice Profile](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-for-legal/blob/main/ai-governance-legal/CLAUDE.md): Written by the cold-start interview.
- [Commercial Contracts Practice Profile](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-for-legal/blob/main/commercial-legal/CLAUDE.md): This file is written by the cold-start interview on first run.
- [Corporate Practice Profile](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-for-legal/blob/main/corporate-legal/CLAUDE.md): Written by cold-start on [DATE].

- [Law School Clinic Practice Profile](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-for-legal/blob/main/legal-clinic/CLAUDE.md): Written by the professor-facing cold-start interview.
